brief: The canvas displays an infinitely interlocking tessellation of hexagonal shapes. These tessellations rotate and flow dynamically, creating mesmerizing, ever-shifting patterns. The individual hexagons maintain a vibrant, nostalgic color palette, but their appearance continuously shifts, with perceptible variations in saturation and localized transparency between adjacent cells. The collective movement is characterized by variable directional flow, causing the interlocking grid to appear as if it is breathing and twisting independently of any external input.

statement: This sketch creates an infinite tessellation of rotating hexagonal shapes using p5.js in WEBGL mode. Each hexagon has its own position, size, rotation speed, and color properties that evolve over time. The hexagons flow and rotate independently, creating a mesmerizing, breathing pattern across the canvas. The use of 3D rendering allows for dynamic camera movement and depth perception, while the continuous color shifts and varying transparency between adjacent cells give each shape a unique appearance within the collective pattern. The animation runs autonomously without any user interaction, fulfilling the requirement for self-contained motion.
